title: The Geometry of Pattern Groups
summary: Coset incidence geometries are an important tool which connect group theory and geometry. While the representations of the unitriangular group and its pattern subgroups have been studied extensively, the underlying geometric structures of these groups has remained largely unexplored. In this article, we construct the natural coset geometry associated with each pattern group over a finite field $\FF_q$, and prove geometrical properties of theses structures.
